db.cell_cut: This value is too big to be loaded whole: it is cut here and cannot be changed from the grid.
db.choices_more: Only the first %{n} values are listed
db.confirm_cascade: Also drop what depends on it (CASCADE)
db.confirm_drop_text: This removes the %{kind} and everything in it. It cannot be undone.
db.confirm_empty_text: Every row is removed; the table stays. It cannot be undone.
db.console_busy_running: A query is running: wait for it, or stop it, before changing the data source.
db.console_busy_transaction: A transaction is open: Commit or Rollback before changing the data source.
db.console_choose_connection: Choose the data source the queries run on.
db.console_no_connection: Add a data source first: the queries run on one.
db.console_shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter runs the selection or the current statement; with Shift, everything.
db.copy_data_failed: The table was made, but its rows were not copied:
db.copy_database_hint: the one of the data source
db.copy_hint: Copied: columns, primary keys, unique and check constraints, indexes, comments. Not copied: foreign keys, triggers, partitioning.
db.dcol_order_note: PostgreSQL cannot move a column: new columns are added at the end. To change the order, create a new table and copy the data.
db.diagram_empty: This schema has no tables to draw
db.dp_needs_columns: A key, constraint or index needs its columns.
db.dp_needs_reference: A foreign key needs the table it points to.
db.dp_no_columns: A table needs at least one column.
db.dp_several_keys: A table has only one primary key.
db.dp_sqlite_limit: This change needs the table to be made again, which SQLite cannot do with ALTER: only adding, renaming and dropping columns, indexes and the name of the table can be done here.
db.driver_file_hint: A driver file of your own, used in place of the downloaded one.
db.driver_missing_plugin: The driver is missing from the plugin: reinstall the Database plugin (Preferences › Plugins).
db.driver_use_bundled: Use the driver of the plugin
db.dsql_hint: Run in one transaction, in this order: all or nothing.
db.err_answer_too_large: The answer of the driver is too large (more than 256 MB). Show fewer rows or fewer columns.
db.err_driver_answer: The driver gave an answer that cannot be read.
db.err_driver_missing: The PostgreSQL driver is not installed: download it from the data source settings.
db.err_timeout: The database did not answer in time.
db.explain_not_read: Explain analyze runs the statement: only a reading statement can be measured
db.file_hint: The path of a SQLite database file. It must already exist.
db.file_not_sql: This file is not SQL: set its language to SQL first.
db.form_open: Open the row as a form
db.guard_no_where: This statement has no WHERE: it changes every row.
db.guard_writes: This is a production source: confirm the change.
db.keyless_table: No primary key: a row is found by its place and its values.
db.links_in: Rows that point to this one
db.links_in_hint: The rows of other tables that refer to it.
db.links_out_hint: The rows it refers to, through its foreign keys.
db.load_stopped: Reading stopped: reload to read again.
db.log_empty: No command run yet. Every SQL command sent to a database is listed here.
db.no_changes: Nothing to commit: the table has no primary key.
db.no_links: This row is linked to no other.
db.not_nullable: This column does not accept NULL.
db.object_filter_hint: type:regex entries separated by |; a - before the regex hides what matches. Types: table, view, mview, ftable. Example: table:-audit_.*
db.opt_production_hint: Every change asked for in the console is confirmed before it runs.
db.opt_read_only_hint: The session cannot change anything: every transaction is read-only.
db.opt_script_hint: SQL run on every connection, before anything else.
db.opt_single_hint: Shows only the database named in the connection, not the other ones of the server.
db.opt_time_zone_hint: For example Europe/Paris or UTC. Empty keeps the server's.
db.opt_timeout_hint: A statement that runs longer is stopped by the server. Empty: no limit; the Stop button of the console stops a query at any time.
db.page_kept_edits: The page that arrived was not shown: it would have erased your changes. Commit or revert them, then refresh.
db.pending_block: Commit or revert the pending changes first.
db.preview_hint: All of it in one transaction, in this order.
db.props_hint: Passed to the connection as is: application_name, connect_timeout, options, target_session_attrs…
db.read_only_table: Read-only: not a table, or the session is read-only.
db.remember_forever_hint: The password is stored in a file only you can read, not in the system keychain.
db.restore_warning_clean: What is in the database and in the backup is dropped, then made again.
db.row_revert: Revert the changes of the row
db.schema_pattern_hint: database:schema,schema entries separated by |. * is all, @ is the current one. Examples: @:* (default), *:public, shop:public,sales.
db.ssh_hint: The host above must be reachable from the SSH machine. The tunnel uses the ssh program of the system. Leave the local port empty to let the system choose.
db.ssh_scanning: Asking the server for its keys…
db.ssh_trust_text: Check that these fingerprints are those of your server (ask its administrator, or run ssh-keygen -lf on its key) before trusting it:
db.ssl_hint: PEM files. verify-ca checks the certificate comes from the CA, verify-full also checks the host name. Without a CA file, the system's authorities are used.
db.where_hint: condition, for example price > 10 AND name LIKE 'a%'
